nodes.title: Provenance upsert infers the partial unique index
nodes.summary: The four INSERT INTO provenance ... ON CONFLICT clauses in the curation repository now repeat their partial unique index's predicate, so recording an already-held fragment as provenance leaves one entry and no longer raises an error.

nodes.title: Proof that each provenance upsert repeats the predicate of its partial unique index
nodes.summary: One table-driven test sends each of the four provenance statements of the curation repository to a recording stand-in client and asserts that its ON CONFLICT clause carries the arbiter columns, the index predicate and DO NOTHING.

nodes.title: Provenance upserts repeat their partial-index predicate: review
nodes.summary: What the coverage, conformance and standard passes found over the curation repository and the test written by the corrective increment provenance-conflict-predicate.
unproven: A corrected attribute takes the provenance entries of the attribute it supersedes.
A corrected link takes the provenance entries of the link it supersedes.
An entity edit that records a new attribute records the fragment of the edit's operator note as the provenance of that attribute.
Recording a fragment as the provenance of a link that already holds it as provenance leaves one provenance entry for that link and that fragment.
Recording a fragment as the provenance of an attribute that already holds it as provenance leaves one provenance entry for that attribute and that fragment.
